questions.prompt: Which architectural pattern is most suitable for isolating UI components in a large-scale application?
questions.explanation: Micro frontends allow independent teams to build and deploy separate parts of the UI, improving scalability.

questions.prompt: In a unidirectional data flow architecture, which component is responsible for propagating state changes to the view?
questions.explanation: The store holds the state and notifies components of changes.

questions.prompt: Which deployment strategy minimizes downtime when updating a single feature of a React application?
questions.explanation: Canary releases allow only a small percentage of users to see the change, reducing risk.

questions.prompt: Which technique is most effective for reducing initial bundle size in a modern SPA?
questions.explanation: Code splitting loads only required modules on demand, reducing payload.

questions.prompt: In a micro-frontend architecture, how should shared dependencies be managed to avoid duplication?

options.text: Each micro-frontend bundles its own copy
Use a shared library served from CDN

questions.explanation: Serving shared libs from CDN ensures a single copy is loaded and cached across micro frontends.
